Overall, artifacts are minor and localized.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the Rhodesian Ridgeback class. Key morphological features (ridge, head shape, coat color, musculature) are present and correct. artifact_reasoning: The image is high quality with no major structural failures.
